Kestrel Ridge Analytics helps retail and fintech teams unify loyalty, transaction and engagement data into one customer view. Founded in 2019 in Pune, about 240 people, serving 90+ brands across India and South-East Asia.

How it works
You share customer and transaction data with us through a secure upload or API. We host it in our cloud environment and return segments, churn scores and campaign insights.

Security and compliance details are in our Trust Center. New customers start with the onboarding questionnaire.
